mission_name: Every Odd Number Greater Than 1 is the Sum of at Most Five Primes

target.statement: theorem rosser_schoenfeld_theta_lower_analytic_mid_lower (t : ℝ) (h1 : 1420 ≤ t) (h2 : t ≤ 10 ^ 9) : t * (1 - 1 / (2 * Real.log t)) < Chebyshev.theta t

new_published_child.statement: theorem rosser_schoenfeld_theta_lower_analytic_finite (t : ℝ) (h1 : 1420 ≤ t) (h2 : t ≤ 10 ^ 8) : t * (1 - 1 / (2 * Real.log t)) < Chebyshev.theta t
new_published_child.why_this_is_the_floor: 10^8 is the hypothesis threshold of the published node TaoFivePrimes.schoenfeld_psi_error_large, so (1420, 10^8] is the smallest range the analytic method cannot reach; no further splitting is possible without replacing that node.

submission.local_check: lake env lean -> exit 0, 53 s; only the expected unusedVariables warning for h2

mathematical_content: range split at 10^8: [1420,10^8] is the new finite child, [10^8,10^9] is analytic
numeric core 2 (log t)^2 < (19/40) sqrt t in two regimes

regime 1 (10^8 <= t <= 2^27): t = 2^26 * z with z <= 2, log t = 26 log 2 + log z <= 26 log 2 + z - 1 < 19.03, and sqrt t >= 10^4, so 2*19.03^2 = 724.3 < 4750 = (19/40)*10^4; the '-1' from log_le_sub_one_of_pos is what makes 10^8 reachable
negative_result_recorded: The platform's certificate technique is NAT-cast based and gives UPPER bounds: exhibit k with Nat.lcmUpto n <= 2^k and let the kernel check it (Chebyshev.psi_eq_log_lcmUpto). theta is the log of a PRIMORIAL, not of an lcm, so there is no small integer to exhibit and the same trick does not give a theta LOWER bound. Certified theta lower bounds therefore need a different mechanism (or a much larger certificate). Recorded in the explanation so the finite node's difficulty is not understated.
